faq.q: Do you handle both design and construction?
faq.a: Yes. One team takes a project from the first sketch to handover, so there is a single contract and a single point of responsibility.

faq.q: How long does a typical house take?
faq.a: Design usually takes three to five months and construction eight to fourteen, depending on size, site and approvals.

faq.q: Can you work on a plot we already own?
faq.a: Yes. We start with a site visit and survey, then confirm what the plot allows before any design fees are committed.

faq.q: Do you work outside your home region?
faq.a: We have delivered projects in more than fifteen countries and partner with local engineers and builders where needed.
After the brief we give a fixed design fee and a budgeted construction estimate that we refine at each design stage.
